meta.title: ChatDemo 1:1
meta.description: Chat inside DSH with the exact request shape of DeepSeek's open-source chat-demo: one-line system prompt, server-side web search and citations, no client tools. Adds a ChatDemo preset and the chatdemo provider; choosing the preset selects the model automatically. Uses your signed-in DSH account or the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY credential reference, and sends requests only to api.deepseek.com.
